findings.summary: The exact non-hidden directory inventory omits the production Skill directory.
findings.evidence: The current production tree contains the non-hidden directory `skills/web-interface-delivery/`, but README-CH.md enumerates only `skills/` and `skills/web-interface-delivery/SKILL.md`. The README-CH.md artifact contract requires every current non-hidden production file and directory to be enumerated in Chinese. The validated ledger, all ten upstream artifact evaluations, and their current SHA-256 bindings passed; `./scripts/domain-check.sh` also passed 43 tests, but its deterministic README check covers production files and the five required top-level directories rather than this nested production directory.
